sections.text:
This document outlines the minor maintenance Procedures P1, to 
be performed 
every six years
as indicated by Y6 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Gamal Foad Sultan and tested at 17 Aug 02, Abu Zaabal 500kv S/S Cairo zone.

items:
A word permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution
 marks surrounding the work area,

Wear the appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, and safety glasses

CB must be isolated completely and
 grounded on both sides.

Ensure that the earthling switch must be must be closed on both sides 
 of the breaker
Complete set of maintenance hand tolls
220V ac supply
Portable pressure gague
Emergency light
Timing equipment
Check tightness of ground terminals and other installation
Check of abnormal noise
Check of rust or damage of components
Check of blind cover for gas feeding inlet
Check of gas pressure and temperature measurement

Check of setting of gas pressure switches:
 Alarm 36 GA (ON) P1 = 4.5 0.3 kg/cm2
 Block 36 GL (ON) P2 = 4.0 0.3 kg /cm2
Check open-close position of gas stop valve
Check of lubrication of mechanism
Check of leakage of shock absorber oil
Check of looseness of retainer ring and nuts
Check of space heaters
Check the position of position indicator
Check of registered number of operation counters
Check of condensation and rust inside housing and water leak into housing
Check of door packing
Check of tightness of polts in housing
Check of control circuit wiring and terminals
Check of manual opining and closing operating

Check of closing and opining time
 closing < 190 ms 
 opening < 26 ms

Measure and record; Air content, Acidity, and Dew 
 point tests for sf6 gas, reference to Approved MPIS document no. TD-SS-004-r0
